newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bavaria declares war on canned beer.
newsitem.headline: Bavaria declares war on canned beer.

text.p: Germany's beer capital Bavaria has declared war against an unlikely invader -- canned beer.

The government in the southern state of Bavaria, where more beer per capita is consumed than in any other part of Germany, said it wanted to protect the giant local beer industry by shunning canned beer.
Bavaria's minister for the environment, Thomas Goppel, called on Bavarian brewers to refrain from using cans for their beer products and stick with the traditional bottles.

Because most bottles are returnable, local brewers have a built-in advantage over brewers from other German states and abroad, who have been using the disposable cans to build up their once-miniscule market share.

"Canned beer is an instrument for non-Bavarian brewers to conquer the Bavarian beer market," Goppel said. "For ecological reasons as well as the market interests of Bavarian brewers, we need to stay away from canned beer."
